scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:api: uv run --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests -m "not integration"
scripts.check:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api && uv run --project apps/api ruff format --check apps/api && uv run --project apps/api mypy apps/api/src
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --project apps/api python apps/api/scripts/export_openapi.py && openapi-typescript packages/contracts/openapi.json -o packages/contracts/src/schema.d.ts
scripts.test:integration: docker compose -p kdmp-foundation-test -f compose.test.yaml run --build --rm tests
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:api && npm run test:api && npm run contracts:check
